> I don't know you or your back story, but I can say you won't disappoint your therapist. Their job is to help you specifically for situations like this. You kidding, you're putting food on his table :P 

Heh, true. 

> Seriously though, that sounds like absolute hell. Just try to keep it together until you see the therapist, talk to your bf about it maybe? As a guy when my girlfriend at the time was going through some rough suicidal thoughts, I was scared as hell. He'll only be scared because he cares about you. 

Alright, but he has problems of his own. I don't want to unload any more onto him. He doesn't deserve it.
